items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And this boy asked him could I pick his name was Bagnet. I said, Mr. Bagnet, I said I broke the middle vowel.

ctx.x: not sure. When you started to pick, were you playing like a four beats to a- Yeah. It was a four beats to a bar. Boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. See, there

used to be two, boom, boom, see. It's like when I come to New York, they had a two beats to a bar. So when I started picking the four, they'll come up, the publishers never got wide, and come up there and started writing four beats to a bar. And then fast numbers the two players couldn't play that, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, see. So that's why everybody tried to learn a string bass and I was shaming the camera string bass around. Now I always wanted to play tuba, you know, I was in Los…
the string bass. Now, Pops, let's get a little background on you. Where were you born?
